2610.13131.title: Looking Ahead and Back: Anticipatory Generative Modeling for Road-Network Trajectories
2610.13131.paper_summary: Trajectory generation underpins urban applications such as traffic management and urban planning. Within road networks, vehicle movement along road segments is largely deterministic, whereas transitions at intersections are critical--multiple outgoing paths may appear equally plausible, yet they can lead to substantially different downstream routes. Existing generative methods such as diffusion models simulate location sequences and fail short of next transition selection, even producing trajectories that drift off the road network. To fill this gap, we advocate a fundamental shift: moving beyond location simulation toward behavior modeling on the road network. In this paper, we revisit trajectory generation through the lens of generative route planning, and introduce a new graph-constrained generative paradigm, Anticipatory Generative Modeling, which resolves next transition selection by incorporating the Anticipation of how the future route may unfold toward the destination. Concretely, we propose a novel generative model named Foresight that formulates a probabilistic model for an "anticipate--select--update--re-anticipate" loop that enables longer-term foresight while continuing sequential generation along the historical trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Foresight wins state-of-the-art baselines.
2610.13131.paper_summary_zh: 城市應用如交通管理和城市規劃的基礎是軌跡生成。<lb/>在道路網絡中，車輛沿著路段的運動在很大程度上是確定性的，而在交叉口的轉換則至關重要——多條出口路徑可能看起來同樣合理，但它們可能導致截然不同的下游路徑。<lb/>現有的生成方法，如擴散模型，模擬位置序列，但在下一次轉換選擇上表現不佳，甚至會產生偏離道路網絡的軌跡。<lb/>為了填補這一空白，我們提倡一個根本性的轉變：超越位置模擬，轉向道路網絡上的行為建模。<lb/>在本文中，我們通過生成路徑規劃的視角重新審視軌跡生成，並引入一種新的圖約束生成範式——預期生成建模，該範式通過納入對未來路徑如何朝向目的地展開的預期來解決下一次轉換選擇問題。<lb/>具體而言，我們提出了一種名為Foresight的新型生成模型，該模型為“預期——選擇——更新——重新預期”循環制定了一個概率模型，這使得在沿著歷史軌跡進行連續生成的同時，能夠實現更長期的前瞻性。<lb/>大量實驗表明，Foresight超越了最先進的基準。
